947	## Algorithm inference
948	
949	```
950	INPUT:  specs      = []ImportSpec{Path string, Alias string /* "" if none */, Comment string}
951	        order      = parsed -imports-order (default std,general,company,project)
952	        sepNamed   = -separate-named
953	
954	# 1. (pre-pass, unrelated to this flag) -rm-unused removes specs; -set-alias fills in Alias
955	#    for versioned paths and for paths whose package name != last path element.
956	#    => both run BEFORE step 2, so tool-generated aliases count as "named".
957	
958	# 2. Bucket every spec into exactly one group according to `order`:
959	#      if "blanked" in order and Alias == "_"  -> blanked
960	#      elif "dotted" in order and Alias == "." -> dotted
961	#      elif isStd(Path)                        -> std
962	#      elif hasCompanyPrefix(Path)             -> company        (only if -company-prefixes set)
963	#      elif isProject(Path)                    -> project
964	#      else                                    -> general
965	#    ("blanked"/"dotted" win over everything else when present in -imports-order.)
966	
967	# 3. Sort each group by the tuple (Path, Alias), byte-wise ascending.
968	#    Unnamed (Alias == "") sorts before every alias for the same Path.
969	#    NOTE: '.' (0x2E) < 'B' < 'Z' < '_' (0x5F) < 'a'  — plain byte order, no case folding.
970	
971	# 4. Emit chunks, in the order given by `order`:
972	chunks = []
973	for g in order:
974	    grp = groups[g]
975	    if grp is empty: continue
976	    if sepNamed:
977	        unnamed = [s for s in grp if s.Alias == ""]      # already sorted
978	        named   = [s for s in grp if s.Alias != ""]      # already sorted
979	        if unnamed: chunks.append(unnamed)
980	        if named:   chunks.append(named)
981	    else:
982	        chunks.append(grp)
983	
984	# 5. Render:
985	text = "import (\n"
986	     + "\n".join( "\n".join("\t" + render(s) for s in chunk) for chunk in chunks )   # chunks joined by ONE blank line
987	     + "\n)\n"
988	   where render(s) = (s.Alias + " " if s.Alias else "") + quote(s.Path) + (" " + s.Comment if any)
989	
990	# 6. Run go/format (format.Source) over the whole file. This is what column-aligns
991	#    trailing comments *within each blank-line-delimited run*.
992	```
993	
994	Key consequences:
995	- "Named" == `ImportSpec.Name != nil`. `_`, `.`, and an alias equal to the package name all qualify.
996	- The named sub-block always follows the unnamed one; there is no way to invert it.
997	- Empty sub-blocks emit nothing, so you never get two adjacent blank lines, a blank line right
998	  after `import (`, or a blank line right before `)`.
999	- Ordering inside the named sub-block is *inherited* from the whole-group path sort — an
1000	  implementation that sorts the group once and then stable-partitions produces identical bytes.
1001	- `blanked` / `dotted` groups are 100 % named, so `-separate-named` is a no-op on them.
